Definition: a Shebaite or descendant of Sheba
BiblicalUsage: The Sabeans are the people of Sheba, and Joel names them as the far-off buyers of Judah's sons and daughters: they shall sell them to the Sabeans, to a people far off, for the LORD hath spoken it. One verse is all the word gets, and it is a verse of judgment turned back on the sellers.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Joel's warning cuts both ways: those who sold God's people will themselves be sold, and no distance puts a people beyond the Lord's reach.
